sections.content: Journey of a River 2 Where I Begin, Where I Flow I have no feet, but I travel far, Through fields and forests, under moon and star.

sections.content: My journey begins high up in the Western Ghats at Trimbakeshwar in Maharashtra.

sections.heading: Learning Point 4
sections.content: Although I start out as a stream, as I move across the land, rainwater and other streams join me, making me wider and stronger.
